title: Script result with proposed effects
description: What a script hands back to the platform: optional changes to the record being saved, and a list of proposed effects. The script never applies an effect itself; the platform checks each one and applies it through the owning engine in the same transaction as the save. Not a definition kind: it describes a script's output, not a stored definition.

record.description: The record's new values. Allowed only on hooks that may change the record (before save, custom button)

effects.description: Proposed effects, applied in this order after the record is written. Empty when the script proposes nothing

money.description: A positive amount in rupees with at most two decimals, preferably as a string such as "1500.00"

effect.description: One proposed effect; its type says which engine applies it

type.description: Post a journal entry, create or update a record, notify people, or call an approved connector

ledgerPropose.description: A journal entry for the ledger. It must balance, every account must exist and be active, and its financial year must be open

date.description: Entry date as an ISO date; its financial year must be open

lines.description: Debits and credits; total debits must equal total credits

fund.description: Fund code, or null for unrestricted

recordsCreate.description: A new record, saved through the full save pipeline with the permissions of the person saving

recordType.description: Record type to create; must be published

data.description: Field values of the new record; validated like a save from the screens

recordsUpdate.description: A change to another existing record at the version the script read, saved through the full save pipeline with the same permissions as a created record. Never the record being saved

recordType.description: Record type of the record; must match it

id.description: Id of the record to update

expectedVersion.description: The version the script read; a newer one refuses the save

data.description: Field values to change; validated like a save from the screens

notify.description: A notification from a published template, queued in the save and sent after it commits

to.description: Who is notified. Addresses always come from people or from the record, never from the script

users.description: These people, by user id; each must belong to the organisation

creator.description: The person who created the record

field.description: A person, email or phone field of the saved record whose value is notified

named.description: Named fixed recipients an administrator keeps in the organisation settings, such as the auditor; each must be declared by the script

channels.description: How it is sent; default in-app and email

values.description: Extra values the template can show as script.<name>

connectorCall.description: A call to an http (send mode) or webhook connector the script declares and an administrator has enabled; queued in the save and delivered after it commits

connector.description: Connector to call; must be in the script's declared connectors

body.description: Values sent next to the record reference: the webhook body, or values an http connector's templates read as record.<name>
